subject.title: fix: strip volatile output from exec result hash to fix no-progress detection (#93917)

question: Should stable failed exec retries ignore volatile output and be allowed to trip critical/global blocking after the configured threshold?
rationale: The patch is a narrow bug fix, but it deliberately changes when OpenClaw stops an agent for repeated failed exec calls, so the availability tradeoff needs maintainer acceptance before merge.

options.title: Accept Stricter Failed-Exec Blocking
options.body: Merge after the docs follow-up and exact-head validation if maintainers agree repeated stable failed exec outcomes should stop runaway sessions.

options.title: Defer For Broader Loop Policy
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want session-global or fuzzy loop-detection semantics settled before changing failed-exec hashing.

recommendation.title: Accept Stricter Failed-Exec Blocking
recommendation.body: Merge after the docs follow-up and exact-head validation if maintainers agree repeated stable failed exec outcomes should stop runaway sessions.
